newsitem.title: UK: NWE high sulphur fuel oil edges lower.
newsitem.headline: NWE high sulphur fuel oil edges lower.

text.p: NWE high sulphur cracked fuel oil prices were slightly softer on Thursday as more avails of straight-run fuel oil appeared on the scene, dealers said.
High sulphur barges were talked close to $115/$116 fob ARA later in the day, after trading slightly above that level.
High sulphur cargoes were at or slightly above that level.
Utility players reported offers of low sulphur material but were uninterested, saying they were not willing to pay more than $1 over high sulphur numbers.
Low sulphur prices appeared to settle at lower levels, with a deal heard done for a Danish cargo at around $116 fob NWE.
A Spanish piece was also heard sold to a trader but the price was not known.
